**Implementation note:** Reservation price and optimal spread; buy-side use only.

## Description

Quote bid and ask around a reservation price adjusted for inventory risk, volatility and order-arrival intensity.

## Where it may fit

Liquid electronic markets with tight spreads, reliable low-latency feeds and controllable inventory/adverse selection.

## Vehicles

Market-making desks in equities, ETFs, futures, FX or crypto; generally a trading firm rather than a mutual-fund strategy.

## Required data

Level-1/level-2 order book, trades, volatility, inventory, order-arrival/fill models, fees, latency and queue position.

## Caveats

The paper is a model reference, not a production-ready strategy; latency, adverse selection, fees and inventory limits are decisive.
